## Practical (Wednesday): Setting up your workstation

* Preparing everything for [Scientific Computing](https://fellennert.github.io/toolbox_css/general_sc.html)
  + Acquire access to _[sc.uni-leipzig.de](www.sc.uni-leipzig.de)_
  + Get a Github account if you don't have one yet
  + Connect your PC and the SC Account with your Github account
* R recap (the corresponding chapters can be found in the R4DS book -- _[online](https://r4ds.hadley.nz))
  + `RMarkdown`/`Quarto` -- chapters 28 & 29
  + `dplyr` -- chapter 4
  + `tidyr` -- chapter 6
  + `ggplot2` -- chapters 2 & 10 & 11 & 12
  + `purrr` & loops in different flavors -- chapter 27
  + functional programming -- chapter 26
  + set up `reticulate` in RStudio -- _[online](https://rstudio.github.io/reticulate/)_

## Lecture (Thursday): 

This week, you will learn the answers to the following questions:

- What are Python basics and how do they compare to R?
- How can I use pandas?
- How do string manipulations in R work?
